Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/whats-new
Fetched: 2026-06-05

# What's new in Copilot Studio

## May 2026 (NEW since prior scan — cache previously topped at April 2026)

- (General availability) Computer use is now generally available, letting agents automate web and desktop apps by controlling browsers and desktop applications on behalf of users.
- Add a prompt node to an agent flow or workflow to make a single AI call with dynamic content and model selection (e.g., translation, structured data extraction).
- Add a Microsoft 365 Copilot node to a workflow to send prompts to Microsoft 365 Copilot or a specific agent (research, audit drafting automation).
- Configure consent-based recording on voice-enabled agents.
- Use the agent inventory schema to discover and audit all Copilot Studio agents in your org from the admin center, API, or Azure Resource Graph.
- (Preview) Review agent readiness and issue status from a consolidated status page (publishing errors, runtime issues, config blocks with severity).
- Use asynchronous responses for agent flows to let long-running processes exceed the two-minute limit.
- (Preview) Automatically create Microsoft Entra agent identities for each agent to scope connector permissions, Conditional Access, and DLP per agent. (also listed Nov 2025)
- (Preview) Add computer use standalone tools to agents and agent flows for modular, reusable UI automation with governance, model selection, observability.
- (Preview) Choose Mistral Medium 3.5 as the primary AI model (experimental, alongside Anthropic, xAI, etc.).

## April 2026

- Configure hold and resume for voice-enabled agents.
- (Preview) Build and deploy real-time voice agents for Copilot Studio and Dynamics 365 Contact Center.
- Trigger agent evaluations automatically using the Copilot Studio connector with Power Automate.
- (Preview) Run automated agent evaluations from a REST API using the Power Platform API.
- Use the agent usage estimator to forecast Copilot credit consumption.
- (Preview) Analyze your agent with custom metrics.
- (General availability) Connect agents to other agents using the agent-to-agent (A2A) protocol.
- (Preview) Add a display name suffix to identify agents across environments.
- (Preview) Use GPT-5.5 Reasoning (Deep) as an experimental model.
- Share analytics access with the new Analytics Viewer role.

## March 2026

- (Preview) Use Work IQ tools to connect Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents to the Work IQ service.
- View and filter detailed lists of user questions and reactions.
- Session transcripts include session-level CSAT; download filtered questions/reactions to CSV.
- Use the Prompt assistant in Prompt builder.
- Add Bing Custom Search as a knowledge source.
- Configure post-call action topics and reprompt messages for voice agents.
- Agent evaluations GA; multi-turn conversation tests.
- ChatGPT-5 GA globally (excl. GCC); Claude Sonnet 4.5/4.6 and Claude Opus GA globally (excl. GCC).
- Use an agent node to call a Copilot Studio agent from an agent flow.

## February 2026

- Improved agent responses for ticket-based M365 Graph connectors (ServiceNow, Azure DevOps).
- Select Claude Sonnet 4.5 (beta) for Computer Use agents.
- Prompt builder: per-prompt content moderation sensitivity; Claude Opus 4.6 / Sonnet 4.5; inline prompt editing.

## January 2026

- (Preview) Agent evaluation enhancements (thumbs feedback, activity maps, CSV template).
- (Preview) Expand computer use (new model support, built-in credentials, audit logging w/ session replay, Cloud PC pooling).
- (GA) Copilot Studio extension for Visual Studio Code.

## December 2025

- Compare multiple agent versions side by side when evaluating with test sets.

## November 2025

- GPT-5 Chat GA for EU/US regions (Nov 24, 2025).
- (Preview) Automatically create Microsoft Entra agent identities for agents.
- Improved SharePoint knowledge retrieval via Work IQ; SharePoint metadata filters.
- Orchestrate multiple agents; link to Microsoft Fabric data agents.
- (Preview) Tool groups (Outlook, SharePoint).
- Copy agents from Microsoft 365 Copilot to Copilot Studio.
- (Preview) Request information action via Outlook.
- New 'copilotstudio' Power Platform API namespace.
- Component collections enhancements (child agents, MCP connector types).

## October 2025

- GPT-4o retired; GPT-4.1 default. Multiple AI models; (Preview) GPT-5.
- Copilot Studio Kit; (Preview) themes; time/cost savings tracking.
- Unified activity/transcript view; (Preview) express-mode flows.
- Use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server; (Preview) test sets.

## September 2025

- (Preview) Computer-Using Agents (CUA) on Windows; Client SDK for native apps; code interpreter in chat.

(Older months unchanged; see prior cache.)
